proof_roadmap.step: Choose M on X restricting to F (local-cohomology finiteness lemma)
Set V_0 = X \ V(J_0) and match opens with ideals J subset J_0
Write the DTs for RGamma_J(M) and the derived completions and identify the limits via Lemma compare-with-derived-completion
Conclude isomorphism for i < s and finiteness via Lemma kill-colimit
